sources.title: S.O. 470(E), closure of Begumpet airport, dated 2008-03-10
sources.dateMeaning: notification date; stated effect 00:01 on 2008-03-16, later superseded
sources.supports: Government notification that IATA code HYD of the existing airport is transferred to Rajiv Gandhi International Airport; also a dated observation of HYD at Begumpet.
sources.limitations: Image-only scan; quote read from the page image. Effect date superseded by S.O.504(E) and a later notification effective 00:01 2008-03-23 whose original was not obtained.

sources.title: Thesis chapter 3.1.1 quoting Indian Gazette notifications
anchors: is hereby transferred to the Bangalore International Airport
sources.supports: Verbatim quotation of S.O.1170(E) (BLR transferred from HAL, effect 00:01 2008-05-23) and the final Hyderabad notification (HYD transferred, effect 00:01 2008-03-23).
sources.limitations: Secondary transcription; original Gazette scans not obtained. BLR effect later moved to 00:01 2008-05-24 per a reproduced MoCA notice (secondary).
